parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description:
The domain name of your website.

> The domain name must be added to your Anti-DDoS instance. Call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return for a paged query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs in Resource Management. If you leave this parameter empty, the instance belongs to the default resource group.
